dataset.title: SynRXN: Reaction Informatics Datasets and Benchmarks
dataset.description: Source-qualified reaction datasets, task metrics, split protocols and reproducible reconstruction.

files.title: BRENDA balanced atom mappings
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate mapping methods on a conservative biochemical reaction subset with computational mapping quality control.
files.description: IUBMB-marked, structure-complete, atom- and charge-balanced BRENDA reactions mapped with SynKit.

files.title: E. coli atom mapping
files.benchmark_role: Compare mapper outputs with curated biochemical reference mappings.
files.description: Biochemical atom-mapping benchmark derived from E. coli reactions.

files.title: EHreact atom mappings
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate atom mapping and reaction-template methods across nine enzymatic and synthetic systems.
files.description: Manually corrected atom-mapped reactions from the EHreact manuscript assay collection.

files.title: EnzymeMap atom mapping
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate atom mapping at scale on enzymatic reactions.
files.description: Enzymatic atom-mapping benchmark from the EnzymeMap reaction collection.

files.title: FlowER composite atom mappings
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate atom mapping on overall transformations spanning at least two elementary transitions.
files.description: Unique multi-step test-set mappings retaining only reacting explicit hydrogens; inputs are canonical unmapped SMILES with removable hydrogens made implicit.

files.title: FlowER elementary atom mappings
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate atom mapping on conserved mechanistic elementary steps from the corrected May-2026 FlowER test split.
files.description: Unique elementary test-set mappings retaining only reacting explicit hydrogens; inputs are canonical unmapped SMILES with removable hydrogens made implicit.

files.title: Golden atom-mapping set
files.benchmark_role: Compare mapper outputs with a curated synthetic reference set.
files.description: Curated synthetic-chemistry atom-mapping benchmark.

files.title: Nature Communications atom mapping
files.benchmark_role: Compare mapping methods on literature-derived reactions.
files.description: Literature-derived reference atom-mapping set.

files.title: Recon3D atom mapping
files.benchmark_role: Compare atom mappers on metabolic reactions.
files.description: Biochemical atom-mapping benchmark derived from Recon3D reactions.

files.title: USPTO 3K atom mapping
files.benchmark_role: Compare mapper accuracy on a compact patent-reaction set.
files.description: USPTO-derived synthetic-chemistry atom-mapping benchmark.

files.title: ECReact classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict hierarchical enzyme classes from reactions.
files.description: Enzyme Commission hierarchy classification benchmark.

files.title: EHreact reaction activity
files.benchmark_role: Predict whether a mapped reaction is active for an assay or enzyme label.
files.description: Long-form binary reaction-assay activity labels from nine EHreact manuscript systems.

files.title: Schneider balanced classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict reaction class from balanced reactions.
files.description: Balanced Schneider reaction-class benchmark.

files.title: Schneider unbalanced classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict reaction class from unbalanced reactions.
files.description: Unbalanced and product-focused Schneider reaction-class benchmark.

files.title: SynTemp hierarchical classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict hierarchical reaction-template labels.
files.description: Reaction-template benchmark with three hierarchical label levels.

files.title: Balanced template classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict template labels from balanced reactions.
files.description: Large balanced reaction-template classification benchmark.

files.title: Unbalanced template classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict template labels from unbalanced reactions.
files.description: Large unbalanced and product-focused template classification benchmark.

files.title: USPTO-50K balanced classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict reaction classes from balanced patent reactions.
files.description: Balanced USPTO-50K reaction-class benchmark.

files.title: USPTO-50K unbalanced classification
files.benchmark_role: Predict reaction classes from unbalanced patent reactions.
files.description: Unbalanced and product-focused USPTO-50K classification benchmark.

files.title: ORDerly condition-prediction benchmark
files.benchmark_role: Predict solvent and generic-agent sets from reactants and desired products, with optional temperature and time targets and retained upstream splits.
files.description: ORDerly-condition v4 train and test records normalized without reclassifying the three generic agent slots.

files.title: FREA generated-label supervision
files.benchmark_role: Complete upstream corpus with recorded-positive and generated-negative labels in separate evidence tiers.
files.description: Complete upstream corpus with recorded-positive and generated-negative labels in separate evidence tiers.

files.title: FREA expert feasibility judgments
files.benchmark_role: 751 expert-labeled reaction proposals; feasibility is distinct from experimental success or yield.
files.description: 751 expert-labeled reaction proposals; feasibility is distinct from experimental success or yield.

files.title: SynEPD polar mechanism annotations
files.benchmark_role: Curated electron-pushing annotations preserving source order, exact and normalized representations, and diagnostic-only delta-consistent cases.
files.description: Curated electron-pushing annotations preserving source order, exact and normalized representations, and diagnostic-only delta-consistent cases.

files.title: B97-D3 activation and reaction energies (legacy b97xd3 key)
files.benchmark_role: Predict activation energy and reaction enthalpy.
files.description: B97-D3/def2-mSVP activation energies and reaction enthalpies in kcal/mol, matched to Grambow b97d3.csv. The legacy key is retained for byte compatibility; this table is not the omega-B97X-D3 subset.

files.title: Cycloaddition free energies
files.benchmark_role: Predict activation and reaction free energies.
files.description: Cycloaddition activation and reaction free-energy benchmark.

files.title: E2 activation energies
files.benchmark_role: Predict activation energies for E2 reactions.
files.description: E2 reaction activation-energy benchmark.

files.title: E2/SN2 activation energies
files.benchmark_role: Predict activation energies across E2 and SN2 mechanisms.
files.description: Combined E2 and SN2 activation-energy benchmark.

files.title: Reaction log rates
files.benchmark_role: Predict log reaction rates.
files.description: Dimensionless log10(k/k_ref) at 1000 K. Source k_ref is 1 in s^-1 for unimolecular or cm^3 mol^-1 s^-1 for bimolecular reactions; reaction order and reference units must be retained.

files.title: Phosphatase conversion
files.benchmark_role: Predict phosphatase conversion.
files.description: Source normalized phosphatase conversion as a dimensionless fraction, not yield percent. Original values and enzyme encodings are preserved.

files.title: RAD-6 reaction enthalpies
files.benchmark_role: Predict reaction enthalpy.
files.description: Forward reaction enthalpies in eV, matched to the native reactiondatabase product; do not pool numerically with kcal/mol enthalpy tables.

files.title: RDB7 activation energies
files.benchmark_role: Predict reaction activation energy.
files.description: 23,852 source-derived directional barriers in kcal/mol from 11,926 CCSD(T)-F12/cc-pVDZ-F12 source records. Forward labels match dE0; reverse labels follow the published preprocessing convention dE0 minus dHrxn298. These are directional rows, not 23,852 independent transition states.

files.title: RGD1 activation energies
files.benchmark_role: Predict activation energy at reaction-dataset scale.
files.description: Large-scale reaction activation-energy benchmark.

files.title: SN2 activation energies
files.benchmark_role: Predict activation energies for SN2 reactions.
files.description: SN2 reaction activation-energy benchmark.

files.title: SNAr activation free energies
files.benchmark_role: Predict source-reported SNAr activation free energies.
files.description: Source ea activation free-energy labels in kcal/mol inferred from experimental rate constants using the Eyring equation at source reaction temperatures; retain this interpretation separately from computed electronic or zero-point barriers.

files.title: Complex reaction rebalancing
files.benchmark_role: Recover balanced reactions for complex transformations and rearrangements.
files.description: Manually validated complex-transformation rebalancing benchmark.

files.title: Missing both sides rebalancing
files.benchmark_role: Recover omitted species on both sides of a reaction.
files.description: Reaction-rebalancing benchmark with species missing from both sides.

files.title: Missing non-carbon rebalancing
files.benchmark_role: Recover omitted non-carbon species.
files.description: Reaction-rebalancing benchmark with missing non-carbon species.

files.title: Missing one side rebalancing
files.benchmark_role: Recover omitted species on one side of a reaction.
files.description: Reaction-rebalancing benchmark with species missing from one side.

files.title: HiTEA chiral-resolution enantiomeric excess
files.benchmark_role: Predict signed experimental product enantiomeric excess from substrate and resolution conditions while preserving the unresolved favored-enantiomer convention.
files.description: Fifty chiral salt-resolution experiments with positive reported product yield and signed product ee measured by chiral SFC-MS; zero-reported-yield rows are excluded rather than labeled as racemic.

files.title: RegioSQM experimental EAS sites
files.benchmark_role: Predict the set of experimentally observed regioselective EAS atom sites using the zero-based atom order of the upstream substrate SMILES.
files.description: Literature-curated electrophilic aromatic substitution substrates with 604 experimentally observed aromatic C-H reaction sites across 535 records.

files.title: USPTO-500 reagent prediction
files.benchmark_role: Predict reagents and catalysts from patent reactions.
files.description: Reagent and catalyst inference benchmark.

files.title: USPTO-50K synthesis
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate single-step synthesis and retrosynthesis methods.
files.description: USPTO-50K synthesis and retrosynthesis benchmark.

files.title: USPTO-MIT synthesis
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate synthesis and reaction-center prediction at scale.
files.description: Large-scale USPTO-MIT synthesis-prediction benchmark.

files.title: Buchwald-Hartwig OOD yield benchmark
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate continuous yield prediction and out-of-distribution generalization across substrates, catalysts, conditions, and contributing campaigns.
files.description: Curated multi-campaign Buchwald-Hartwig amination records normalized from the BH-HTE-OOD source, with out-of-range yields quarantined.

files.title: HiTEA reaction yield benchmark
files.benchmark_role: Evaluate yield prediction on diverse high-throughput reaction classes with structured experimental context and abundant zero-yield observations.
files.description: High-throughput experimentation records from the public HiTEA chemical reactome table with atom maps removed and analytical metadata retained.

files.title: USPTO patent yield benchmark
files.benchmark_role: Train and evaluate large-scale continuous yield prediction while retaining the published upstream partitions.
files.description: Lowe USPTO patent reactions curated into numerical-yield train, validation, and test partitions by Schwaller and co-workers.
